name: visual-storytelling-pack
description: Portable visual direction and image generation skills for authored visual storytelling.

interface.shortDescription: Author visual composition and generate raster assets with truthful custody.
interface.longDescription: A focused visual-storytelling bundle: directing-visual-stories makes authored composition and medium-translation decisions; generating-images executes approved raster-image briefs as a substantial Apache-2.0 derivative of OpenAI's bundled imagegen.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use directing-visual-stories to author the composition and story job first; use generating-images only to execute an approved raster-image direction.
